NEMA 4X enclosure containing the converter, input breaker, output power-supply connections, status LEDs and surge protection.
Voltage variants: 230 / 380 / 415 / 440 / 460 V AC input; 12 / 24 V DC output. Output powers 250 W / 500 W / 1 kW / 2 kW. Adjustable overpressure shutdown proximity switch enables interlock with ESD logic and shutdown sequencers.
Pressure ranges to 15,000 psi available. SS316 wetted connections; NACE MR-0175 on request. | Coriolis Mass Flowmeter (NRD), 2-inch, Cementing Service, Local + Remote Display: Coriolis-tube mass flowmeter providing simultaneous mass flow, fluid density, and fluid temperature outputs. Used as a non-radioactive densitometer (NRD) for cementing units, hydration units, and Liquid Additive Systems where radioactive source devices are restricted.
2-inch process connections as standard; 1-inch and 3-inch available. Local digital display + 4-20 mA remote outputs. ATEX Zone 1 / 2 enclosure variants. | Multi-Channel Data Acquisition System, 15-inch Touchscreen, USB Export, Frac-Fleet Ready: Multi-channel oilfield Data Acquisition System engineered for pumping-unit and frac-fleet integration. Compatible signal types: 4-20 mA, 0-5 V, pulse, frequency. 15-inch touchscreen (9-inch and 11-inch variants available).
Operator-configurable display modes: data, chart, curves. Local storage and USB export in ASCII / Excel for post-job reports. Network connectivity (wired / wifi) to fleet Data Vans for centralized fleet control. | Explosion-Proof Electrical Panel, Aluminium-Cast, ATEX Zone 1, 600 mm × 800 mm: Explosion-proof aluminium-cast electrical panel for ATEX Zone 1 hazardous-area deployment. 600 mm × 800 mm internal envelope; multiple sizes available. IECEx-certified variants available. Weatherproof steel-sheet enclosure (powder-coated) for non-hazardous deployment as a lower-cost option. IP65 / IP66 sealing as standard. | Electronic Pressure Sensor, 0-15,000 psi, 2-inch Fig.1502M, 4-20 mA: 0-15,000 psi electronic pressure sensor with 2-inch Fig.1502M HP hammer-union connection. 4-20 mA loop output; HART / digital options available. SS316 wetted parts as standard; NACE MR-0175 materials for sour-service.
Pressure ranges 0-5,000 / 0-10,000 / 0-15,000 / 0-20,000 psi. Temperature compensation calibrated across operating range. | Magnetic Flowmeter, 2-inch Wafer, 600 psi, 4-20 mA Output: 2-inch wafer-style magnetic flowmeter with 600 psi MAWP and 4-20 mA loop output. Sizes 1/2 inch to 12 inch available; pressure ratings to ANSI 600. ATEX Zone 1 explosion-proof variant on request. | Magnetic-Pickup Proximity Sensor, 5/8-18 UNF, M12 Connector, Stroke / RPM Counter: Magnetic-pickup proximity sensor used as a bolt-counter on triplex / quintuplex pump crank shafts to feed RPM and calculated displacement back to the unit DAQ. 5/8-18 UNF threaded body with M12 4-pin connector.
No onboard power required — output is a passive signal proportional to shaft speed. Hazardous-area-rated variants available. | Bimetal Thermometer + Thermowell Pair, 1/2-inch NPT M×F, P+U API 6A Range, SS316: Matched bimetal thermometer and thermowell pair. The thermometer has a 1/2-inch NPT male connection with selectable stem length (2.5, 4, 6, 9 inch) and an API 6A P+U temperature range (-20 °F to +250 °F).
The thermowell is integral construction in SS316 with 1/2-inch NPT male-to-female connections, sized to match the thermometer stem. SS304 wetted-parts variant available. Pressure rating to 15,000 psi at process side; bore size selectable. | Turbine Flowmeter, 2-inch Fig.1502 F×M, 15,000 psi, Frac / Cementing Service: 2-inch turbine flowmeter for high-pressure frac and cementing service. Fig.1502 F×M connections at 15,000 psi MAWP. Optical or magnetic pickup output with K-factor calibration certificate.
3-inch and lower-pressure variants available. NACE MR-0175 materials on request for sour-service applications. | VFD Package, AC Motor + Drive, 500 HP, ATEX Zone 2, Frac-Pumper Compatible: VFD (Variable Frequency Drive) package supplying a 500 HP AC motor for oilfield pump duty. Replaces costly DC converter and DC motor systems on legacy units. ATEX Zone 2 enclosure; regenerative braking option for energy recovery on deceleration.
Motor + drive system rated for offshore environment (saltwater, vibration, temperature). Sizes 100 / 250 / 500 / 750 / 1,000 HP available. Compatible with frac pumper, cementing unit, transfer pump and stimulation unit deployments.

Figures of this listing, as shown on its product page: 2-inch wafer-style magnetic flowmeter with 600 psi MAWP and 4-20 mA loop output. Designed for water, brine, mud and acid-resistant lining where chemistry requires. Local display optional; remote display via 4-20 mA into DAQ.
Sizes 1/2 inch to 12 inch available; pressure ratings to ANSI 600. ATEX Zone 1 explosion-proof variant on request.

ATEX Zone 1 is an area where an explosive gas atmosphere is likely to occur occasionally in normal operation; Zone 2 is an area where it is not likely in normal operation and, if it occurs, lasts only for a short time. Ex-d denotes flameproof enclosure protection.
extraFacts.source: ATEX workplace Directive 1999/92/EC annex I; IEC 60079-0 / 60079-1 (flameproof enclosure 'd')

extraFacts.fact: A 4-20 mA signal is a standard analogue current loop in which 4 mA is the bottom of the range and 20 mA the top, so a broken wire can be told from a zero reading.
extraFacts.source: IEC 60381-1 (analogue signals for process control, 4 to 20 mA)

faqs.q: What is a 2-inch wafer magnetic flowmeter with a 600 psi rating used for?
faqs.a: It is a 2-inch wafer-style magnetic flowmeter with a 600 psi MAWP and a 4-20 mA loop output, for water, brine, mud and acid-resistant lining where the chemistry requires. See the [magnetic flowmeters shelf](/c/ic-magnetic-flowmeters).

faqs.q: What sizes and pressure ratings do the magnetic flowmeters come in?
faqs.a: Sizes from 1/2 inch to 12 inch are available, with pressure ratings to ANSI 600. This listing is 2-inch at 600 psi. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What output does the magnetic flowmeter give?
faqs.a: A 4-20 mA loop output, with local display optional and remote display via 4-20 mA into a [data acquisition system](/c/ic-data-acquisition). Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What fluids is the magnetic flowmeter designed for?
faqs.a: Water, brine, mud and acid-resistant lining where chemistry requires. A magnetic flowmeter needs a conductive fluid. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: What does MAWP mean on the magnetic flowmeter?
faqs.a: MAWP means maximum allowable working pressure, here 600 psi. Do not run the flowmeter above it. Send us the details and we confirm the specification before supply.

faqs.q: Is an explosion-proof magnetic flowmeter available?
faqs.a: An ATEX Zone 1 explosion-proof variant is available on request. Tell us the zone when you ask. Share the duty and any standard that applies and we will confirm the match.

faqs.q: How is the wafer-style magnetic flowmeter fitted?
faqs.a: A wafer meter sits between two pipe flanges, so the line needs matching flanges rated for 600 psi. Quote the flange standard when you ask.

faqs.q: How do I choose a magnetic flowmeter size?
faqs.a: Match the meter bore to the line size, from 1/2 inch to 12 inch, and the pressure to ANSI 600. See the [oilfield instrumentation guide](/blog/oilfield-pressure-and-flow-instrumentation). Tell us the application and we check it against the specification.

faqs.q: What do I need to tell Indus to quote the the 2-inch wafer magnetic flowmeter?
faqs.a: Quote the full title, Magnetic Flowmeter, 2-inch Wafer, 600 psi, 4-20 mA Output, with the variant, size or voltage you need, and say where it will be used and which standard or zone applies. We confirm the specification and lead time on the quotation; start on [our contact page](/contact).

faqs.q: Magnetic or turbine flowmeter: which should I choose?
faqs.a: The magnetic meter suits conductive fluids at lower pressure (600 psi), while the [turbine flowmeter](/p/turbine-flowmeter-2-inch-fig-1502-f-m-15-000-psi-frac-cementing-service) is built for 15,000 psi frac and cementing service.

faqs.q: Where is the magnetic flowmeter supplied from?
faqs.a: We supply it from Dubai, UAE and ship worldwide. Send the size and lining. If you are unsure, send us the requirement and we will confirm.

faqs.q: Is the 2-inch wafer magnetic flowmeter in stock in Dubai?
faqs.a: Yes, we carry the 2-inch wafer magnetic flowmeter in stock at our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Request pricing for your sizes through [our contact page](/contact).
